## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `popcount32` (32-bit registered population count of a) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module popcount32 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire valid_i,
    input wire [31:0] a_i,
    input wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg valid_o,
    output reg [5:0] y_o
);

wire [5:0] pc_0 = 6'd0 + {5'd0, a_i[0]} + {5'd0, a_i[1]} + {5'd0, a_i[2]} + {5'd0, a_i[3]} + {5'd0, a_i[4]} + {5'd0, a_i[5]} + {5'd0, a_i[6]} + {5'd0, a_i[7]} + {5'd0, a_i[8]} + {5'd0, a_i[9]} + {5'd0, a_i[10]} + {5'd0, a_i[11]} + {5'd0, a_i[12]} + {5'd0, a_i[13]} + {5'd0, a_i[14]} + {5'd0, a_i[15]} + {5'd0, a_i[16]} + {5'd0, a_i[17]} + {5'd0, a_i[18]} + {5'd0, a_i[19]} + {5'd0, a_i[20]} + {5'd0, a_i[21]} + {5'd0, a_i[22]} + {5'd0, a_i[23]} + {5'd0, a_i[24]} + {5'd0, a_i[25]} + {5'd0, a_i[26]} + {5'd0, a_i[27]} + {5'd0, a_i[28]} + {5'd0, a_i[29]} + {5'd0, a_i[30]} + {5'd0, a_i[31]};

wire [5:0] total_0 = pc_0;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o <= 6'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;
        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= total_0;
    end
end
endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 264.67 um^2, WNS 7.01636 ns, score 69.89893.
estimate_ppa on this RTL returns area 198.436 um^2, WNS 7.09149 ns, estimated score 70.716464 (estimates omit tap cells, buffering and wiring, so compare estimates with estimates).

## Rules
- One module of synthesizable Verilog-2005 (no helper modules or instances; the equivalence checker compares flat modules). The module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: simulate, prove_equivalence, estimate_ppa, place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: I'll start by measuring a couple of restructured popcount formulations with the cheap estimator.
Both `+`-based variants map to the identical netlist — Yosys canonicalizes them. Let me try a hand-built carry-save (Wallace) tree in pure gates.
Good progress but less than hoped. Let me calibrate how much of the delay is fixed overhead (input path) with two throwaway probes.
Key insight: `y_o[5]` is simply `&a_i` (count==32), which is far cheaper than the adder's carry-out. Let me bank the current tree with P&R while testing that idea.
Banked 71.44. Now testing two refinements: an AOI-friendly enable/reset formulation on the register path, and a cheaper all-ones detector reusing tree signals.
The AOI-style register rewrite hurt slightly (keep original), but the internal all-ones detector saved 15 um². Let me combine the winners and test one rebalanced tree schedule.
Estimates have plateaued (~7.25 ns) across very different tree structures, suggesting ABC's optimizer is the limiter. Let me spend a submission on the lowest-area member of that class (V8).
Last submission: the variant with the highest measured estimate WNS (full AND-tree all-ones detector), verified in parallel.
